// Reference translation of pie_list `cmp_id` (corpus/src/pie_list.c).

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

/// `return a->id - b->id;` The subtraction wraps, as the generated code does.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn cmp_id(a: *const Record, b: *const Record) -> i32 {
    unsafe { (*a).id.wrapping_sub((*b).id) }
}

// Reference translation of pie_list `cmp_dist` (corpus/src/pie_list.c).

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

fn dist2(p: &Point) -> i32 {
    p.x.wrapping_mul(p.x).wrapping_add(p.y.wrapping_mul(p.y))
}

/// Squared distance from the origin of each record's position; returns their difference.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn cmp_dist(a: *const Record, b: *const Record) -> i32 {
    unsafe { dist2(&(*a).pos).wrapping_sub(dist2(&(*b).pos)) }
}
</kraken-rust>

# Behavioural spec: cmp_id (pie_list)

## Purpose

`cmp_id` is a three-way style comparator for two records. It orders them by their integer id and returns the plain difference of the ids rather than -1, 0 or 1.

## Inputs

- `a`: pointer to a 40-byte `struct record`; only the `int` id at offset 0 is read. [@0x10124e]
- `b`: pointer to a second `struct record`, read the same way. [@0x10124e]

## Outputs

- Returns `int`: `a->id - b->id` computed in 32-bit two's complement, so the result wraps when the true difference does not fit. [@0x10124e]
- A positive result means `a` sorts after `b`, a negative one before, zero means equal ids. [@0x10124e]

## Side effects

- None: nothing is written through either pointer and nothing is printed. [@0x10124e]

## Invariants

- The result depends only on the two ids; the names, positions and weights of the records are never read. [@0x10124e]
- `cmp_id(a, a)` is 0 for every `a`. [@0x10124e]
